column1: # note: Form IL-1040 line 12: "Residents: Multiply Line 11 by 4.95% (.0495). Cannot be less than zero." A flat rate, so one bracket for each filing status. Illinois prints no tax table.
# note: The instructions say to round cents to whole dollars on Form IL-1040 (instructions, page 4, "Should I round?"); the test rounds line 12 so.
